instruction: Please center the text layer vertically on the canvas. I want it positioned in the middle height of the image.

metadata.explanation: Task requires centering the text layer vertically on the canvas. The evaluator finds the vertical bounds of the text and checks if its vertical center is within 10% of the image's vertical center.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies vertical centering by finding text bounds and comparing center position to image center
Postconfig properly exports the GIMP image to PNG format for evaluation, ensuring state can be verified
10% tolerance is reasonable for visual alignment tasks
Complete coverage of instruction requirement (vertical centering)
Expected parameter handling is correct - metric receives empty dict from get_rule and doesn't incorrectly access expected.get('rules')
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Metric assumes dark text (grayscale < 128) which may fail if text is light-colored. Consider checking for both dark and light text, or using edge detection.

Minor: Edge case not handled - if no text pixels are found (all pixels > 128), top_most=height and bottom_most=0 would incorrectly calculate center as height/2 and return 1.0. Should add validation that text was actually detected.
